pr_title: Improve logging and handling when websocket gets behind
pr_body:
## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
At startup its still a bit to likely that the websocket can get behind because
we fire so many state changes at once.  This results in a disconnection
when we reach max pending messages and reconnect right away which
does a bit of thrashing. 

To address this, the limits have been increased, processing messages
has been optimized a bit, and the logging has been improved to give
more information about the client and the last message when we
do exceed the limit.

Tested using `scaletest` with 1500 entities https://github.com/bdraco/scaletest/blob/5900ee4a15dda53083ce271d82b03136cdd883be/custom_components/scaletest/sensor.py#L20 with #86855 and #86856 merged in as well.  It previously hit the limit right at startup before these changes.

I picked 1500 because thats the point where the frontend becomes
the bottleneck

#86855 and #86856 will likely help performance more
